players.4ua: Lives in the hard fights. Activity is near 2 and Resist is well above average, so he's often up against strong players. His public K/D of 2.4 drops to about 1.9 once the opposition is weighted, so part of that number came from easier fights. Steady pace, about one kill a minute.
players.bhorn: The fastest killer in this group, about 1.3 kills a minute, with the highest public K/D here at 4.0. A lot of that comes from softer opposition: once weighted it falls to about 1.1, and his results drop further against the toughest players. Big volume, less steady when it gets hard.
players.ahorn: A middle-pace player whose public K/D of about 3 falls to 0.9 once the opposition is weighted. Most of his kills come against softer players, so the lifetime number paints him better than his tougher fights do. Based on 50 opponents, so treat it as a rough read.
players.tvink: Busy, consistent player. His public K/D of about 3 holds up to around 1.6 when weighted for opposition, and Activity is high, so he's regularly in real fights. The data is from 2022, so it's an old snapshot and his play may have changed since.
players.shlodog: Low-volume, slow-paced player, about 0.4 kills a minute, who doesn't often meet strong opposition. Results sit below average, but his K/D falls off less than most players here as the fights get tougher. A calm, low-risk style.
